fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Stratified Tank Combi System
source: Duffie & Beckman (2013), Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes, 4th ed., Wiley (Hottel-Whillier collector eq. 6.7.6, stratified tank multinode eqs. 8.4); oemof.thermal stratified_thermal_storage docs (2020)

unit.name: Residential Solar Combi System — flat-plate collector + 500 L multi-node stratified store + gas auxiliary

F_R_tau_alpha.note: Hottel-Whillier optical efficiency F_R*(tau*alpha); intercept of efficiency curve (Duffie & Beckman Table 6.x flat-plate)

F_R_U_L.note: Hottel-Whillier overall loss coeff F_R*U_L; slope of collector efficiency curve

mdot_coll.note: Collector loop mass flow (~0.02 kg/s per m2, Duffie & Beckman recommended)

cp_water.note: Specific heat of liquid water at ~20-60C (CRC Handbook / Duffie & Beckman); hardcoded property

V_tank.note: Total storage tank volume (500 L combi store)

N_nodes.note: Number of stratified tank nodes (top=hot, bottom=cold)

U_tank.note: Tank wall heat-loss coefficient (insulated store, oemof.thermal default range 0.3-1.0)

k_eff.note: Effective vertical conductivity of water column (thermal conduction between nodes, Duffie & Beckman 8.4)

T_set_aux.note: Auxiliary backup setpoint for top node (60C)

Q_aux_max.note: Maximum auxiliary (gas/electric) backup power into top node

pump_dT_on.note: Differential controller: pump ON when T_collector_out - T_tank_bottom > dT_on

pump_dT_off.note: Differential controller: pump OFF below this dT (anti short-cycle)
